scripts.build: npm run build -w @octelium/apis && npm run build -w @octelium/sdk && npm run build -w @octelium/cordium
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run check:examples -w @octelium/cordium && npm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/cordium/src packages/cordium/test packages/cordium/examples packages/cordium/*.md scripts/*.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/cordium/src packages/cordium/test packages/cordium/examples packages/cordium/*.md scripts/*.mjs
